simple: Agentless privileged access management: discovers all privileged accounts — of people, machines and applications, including forgotten and shadow ones — and stores their passwords in an encrypted vault with automatic rotation. Grants access only for the duration of a task (Just-In-Time) with approval by role and time, records administrator sessions on video and shows them live so abuse can be spotted. Works with servers, cloud, DevOps and OT/SCADA; prepares reports for audits. Includes MySafe — an enterprise password manager for employees: encrypted vault, strong password generation, safe sharing of access without revealing the password, one-time codes (TOTP) and a warning if a password has shown up in leaks. Segura’s main product: one all-inclusive license, with no separate editions; cloud, on premises or hybrid.
